_readme: exclude: links the keyword filter picked up that are not about faith-based persecution. add: headlines checked by hand or by the daily search agent: { title, source, date (YYYY-MM-DD), link, country?, why? }. Use the outlet's own headline exactly, never article text. Entries older than 60 days can be removed.

add.title: Christians in India Lose Ancestral Home for Faith in Christ
add.why: A family was told to return to Hinduism or leave the village, and left after a mob attack.

add.title: Authorities in Egypt Hold Christian Incommunicado
add.why: Reports detention of a Coptic Christian over religious expression online.

add.title: Suspected Boko Haram Militants Threaten to Kill Pastor’s Wife, Sell Daughter
add.why: The pastor says his wife was singled out from a vehicle because she was Christian.

add.title: Christians Rendered Homeless in Chhattisgarh’s Tribal Belt
add.why: Families were evicted or had homes destroyed after refusing to give up their faith.

add.title: Nigerian Christian woman sentenced to 14 years for sharing her faith
add.why: Reports a conviction for sharing Christian faith, heard by a court in Borno State.

add.title: Christian families assaulted by extremists in West Bengal, India
add.why: Christian families were attacked and forced to perform religious rites of another faith.
